title: Marvel Super Heroes Commander: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Avengers assemble!"
"Kneel before Doom."
"Ultron. We would have words with thee." —Thor
"If you knock me down, you'd better make sure you take me out."
"We can win this, Cap! Don't try and stop me."
"Let us act as dead women should." —Aneka, to Ayo
The Ultimate Nullifier, the one weapon Galactus fears, holds the means to lay waste to a universe.
"Now, it is I who possess the Power Cosmic!" —Doctor Doom
"My association with the Avengers is far more than a job. It's more a duty of friendship and loyalty. A calling I cherish deeply."
"Daddy went and built a very bad machine and forgot to tell anyone. Guess who just found it?"
"No job too small. No villain too big."
"You know, not every caper takes place in New York." —Hawkeye, Clint Barton
"It matters not how many times we are defeated. HYDRA is eternal." —Baron Strucker
"Turn, Reed Richards! Turn and face those who will destroy you!" —Wizard
"Ben, I've never needed eyes to see the gentleness of your soul."
She streaks across the desert sky in search of those who would do evil.
All alone in his room, a boy created a baby universe.
"Join me, run, or die. The choice is yours."
"Nothing is safe from me. Not even your mind."
The Human Torch channels every iota of his power into a single burst—a burst that rivals the energies of an exploding star!
"Knock knock!"
"I do my best talking with my fists."
"I speak for Black Bolt. We will not stand for those who would threaten our Terrigen and the safety of our people."
"Direct me to that which you wish stomped flat. It shall be done."
"Each of us is strong. Together, we are unbreakable."
Zuri is a veteran of T'Chaka's army and a mentor to his son. He is one of the few entrusted to carry the spear of Bashenga, the founder of the Panther tribe.
"Break into vaults? Very 'old me.' Slip into vaults through subatomic gaps? Now we're talking." —Ant-Man, Scott Lang
Higher. Further. Faster. More.
"We ignored the risks and the cosmic rays tore through our ship. That's how it all began."
"Attilan can't stay hidden forever. It's time we showed them how fantastic we are."
"If I miss, it means I've been fooling myself this whole time. So I don't."
"They want to tear us apart, Vizh. We won't let them. We can't."
"IMPERIUS REX!"
"My king is merciful. I am not."
"Tiresome, this. Next time, try to keep up."
"To me, my Super Apes!"
"The rings are heavy with responsibility, but I don't mind. I can handle the weight."
"I am king of Wakanda. A line unbroken. A crown unconquered."
Neither snow nor rain nor Doombots nor Galactus stays him from his appointed rounds.
"Time itself yields to Doom."
"You wouldn't like me when I'm angry either, Banner." —Iron Man, Tony Stark
No mere costume, the mantle of the Panther is not a prize to be won. It is a legacy to be earned.
Mena Ngai, where the heaven-sent metal dwells.
After the Skrull invasion of Earth was thwarted, they volunteered to do no more harm in exchange for a peaceful life.
"I'm still Frankie Raye. Just a newer, better Frankie Raye. And I'm free!"
"Enjoy your family, Richards. And remember every time you look at your wife and daughter that Doom saved them both . . . when you could not."
"You're not the first two-bit tyrant I've punched in the face." —Captain America, Steve Rogers
There are few ways to enter Wakanda, but there are many ways to leave.
When evil arises, heroes are born.
"What am I supposed to do with this?" —Everett K. Ross, State Department liaison
For the priests of Wakanda, no duty is more sacred than the preparation of the heart-shaped herb.
"The Supreme Intelligence is defenseless now. I just hope we're doing the right thing." —Black Knight, Dane Whitman
"Namor thinks himself safe beneath the waves. Show him how wrong he is." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
"I've never needed to use this. Don't make me start now."
"I ain't a man any more. I'm just . . . a monster." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
"Gotta get that corn planted before the world ends again." —Clint Barton
"Vibranium can absorb, and it can also reflect." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
"Your mundane wizardry will not harm the Sorcerer Supreme." —Doctor Strange
"You have a lovely face. Mind if I borrow it?"
One thing is sure: Reed Richards will always overthink things.
It is in the nature of a hero to inspire others.
"Why vote for a mere mortal when you can vote for a god?"
"This was supposed to be a stealth mission. I can't take you noisy boys anywhere!" —Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff
A carefully placed word in the right ears can be as devastating as Ragnarok itself.
"Initiating brain wave transferal protocol." —Ultron
"Hell is real, Richards. I will show you!" —Doctor Doom
"Now watch as I do what you could not." —Namor the Sub-Mariner
Loki chortled. "The trap is sprung, and Loki has achieved his most brilliant jest!" Thor prepared a thunderous reply. "Ribbit ribbit!"
Boomerang managed to assemble a squad that really wasn't all that sinister and certainly wasn't all that six.
"C'mon in. Make yourself at home. Here, let me take your things." —Molecule Man, Owen Reece
Raw vibranium is hazardous to any who touch it, causing irreversible mutations.
The migration of the cranes is believed to be a portent of coming abundance in Wakanda.
"Don't get so caught up in the science that you forget to embrace the wonder in front of you." —Reed Richards, to Valeria Richards
"You have done well, Child of Bast. Now rest, sit in the shade of the country you have fought for, and heal. For at least a moment, until you are called to fight again."
"The strength of Wakanda lies in more than its technology." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
"How can you build a better future without first looking to the past?" —Queen Mother Ramonda
The Black Panther is only the tip of Wakanda's spear.
"Three against four. I like our odds." —Human Torch, Johnny Storm
"Whaddaya say Flame-Os, let's put on a real show!" —Human Torch, Johnny Storm
Thanks to time travel, Nathaniel Richards had many second chances to set things right.
"Kang, ol' buddy, you think you know all about time? Ben, tell Kang what time it is!" —Human Torch, Johnny Storm
"It's nothing personal, kid. It's just money."
"If you let me play with your toys, I'm definitely gonna break them." —She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
"I think, therefore I annihilate!"

"The new ID cards are amazing! Instant communication with any Avenger worldwide, top level security clearance in over a hundred countries, and ten percent off at the cafe downstairs!" -She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
"Thing Rings, do your thing." —Ms. Thing, Darla Deering
"We are everywhere. We are HYDRA." —[Name redacted]
"This royal ring is a small thing, but it is everything. My birthright, the symbol of my home." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
T'Challa merged vibranium technology with organic matter to create a jungle of boundless potential.
T'Challa summoned the legions of Panthers past, and the dead rallied to their now and forever king.
"A weapon without a warrior is just a useless hunk of metal." —Ronin, Clint Barton
"They can't hit what they can't see." —Invisible Woman, Sue Storm
"My vibranium Hulkbuster absorbs and amplifies energy, Hulk. I'd advise you to calm down." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
The Hand is comprised of many ninja factions united under the banner of the Beast, an ancient demon who grants them dark, mystical strength.
Mjölnir knows who is worthy to wield it.
When M.O.D.O.K. plays head games, he always comes out on top.
"The subject of innovation will always be near and dear to my heart." —Tony Stark
"Sometimes a hero has to let everyone know that he's there for them. Sometimes he has to say it with fire in the sky." —Human Torch, Johnny Storm
It was not the first time Doom had cackled triumphantly upon completing an instrument of global domination. But this time felt different.
"The mantle of the Black Panther is not taken lightly, my son. Power is a burden, and the king is ever a servant." —King T'Chaka
"Most people run from their problems. I run straight at mine." —Speed Demon, James Sanders
"Never forget who you are and where you came from." —Captain Marvel, Carol Danvers
"See my name? See the name of the company? Now tell me again that I'm asking for the impossible."
Ultron created endless backups, each containing his accumulated data and his ruthless core directive to reign supreme.
Sent from another dimension that prizes chaos above all else, the Zodiac Key exists only to perpetuate eternal conflict.
"What do I think? I think you need to open that door." —Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
"I call it a solar gem. It powers my vision of tomorrow. The gem absorbs sunlight and functions like a human brain . . . but hundreds of times more powerful." —Professor Phineas Horton
A panther does not announce its presence. It stalks its prey unseen.
"I have seen the wonders of the world, but none of them can rival the sunsets of Wakanda." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
Gamma radiation destroys all it touches, save for an unlucky few.
"My body may be imprisoned on the Isle of Silence, but my magic is free to seek revenge!" —Loki
"Once again, a nice weekend in the countryside does *not* mean your industrial campus a few miles from downtown, Tony!" —Pepper Potts
"Of course the Triskelion is a big gaudy target. And anyone who's confident enough to think about taking it out is someone we want on our radar." —Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
"Four Freedoms Plaza is a heckuva name, Stretch. We better make sure we live up ta it." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
"Watch your step when in Castle Loki. The architect is a known trickster." —Loki
"The Royal Palace of Wakanda is more than a home to our royal family. It is a constant reminder of the blessings of Bast that protect our people." —Changamire, Wakandan philosopher
"Hear me, nations of the world! This place now stands uninhabited and ungoverned. Eternal proof that human life cannot stand against the steel of machinery!" —Ultron
"It appears Wakanda is not forever." —Namor the Sub-Mariner
"The mechanisms of evolution do their work upon the Savage Land, as they do everywhere. I only hasten the process." —High Evolutionary, Herbert Wyndham
In the Blue Area of the moon lies a garden sculpted by alien hands, where the one called the Watcher stands witness.
"Well? You coming in or what?" —The One Above All
"I was baptized in gamma radiation and reborn into greatness." —Leader, Samuel Sterns
Once a symbol of hope, now a sinister reminder.
"Our villages are the lifeblood of Wakanda. When the common people prosper, so do we." —Queen Mother Ramonda
"Time to find out if the heads keep growing back if you burn them with fire." —Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
"O beautiful for spacious skies, for amber waves of grain." —"America the Beautiful"
"Doom doesn't demand adulation! The people simply take it upon themselves to recognize greatness." —Doctor Doom
"It may not be the most extravagant or awe-inspiring House of the Deadly Hand of all time, but it's here and it's home." —Shang-Chi
"I think you'll find that our little island will make an ideal base for your Quinjets!" —Stingray, Walter Newell
The Sentry's Watchtower lay just beyond sight for decades, until his memory returned.
"I been ta space, a buncha dimensions 'n' universes . . . and I always end up right back here on Yancy Street." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
"Just because you have ravaged your natural resources and paved over your forests, do not think we have made the same mistake." —King T'Chaka, to the United Nations
The remnants of titanic clashes, immortalized by the desert sands.
"Greatest city on Earth, I'm telling youse. Next month, it'll be like it never happened." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
"Sheesh. Ya call a place Monster Isle and wotta ya expect? It's not gonna be full a' petunias and bunny bun buns." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
There are regions of Subterranea where even the Moloids dare not tread, lest they never return. Or worse, lest they do.
In times of trouble, Wakandans still look to the throne for reassurance.
"Our moment of crisis is now at hand!" —Uatu, the Watcher
"Fight you? I don't need to fight you. That's what I made *him* for." —The Mad Thinker
S.H.I.E.L.D. keeps watch over the land, sea, and stars.
"Nobody remembers who built it. She has watched over these lands for as long as we can remember. As eternal as Bast herself." —Shuri
The uses of vibranium are near limitless, much like the clean energy flowing from Birnin Zana's primary reactor core.
"I now control every molecule in the universe and even beyond!"
"Director Fury's not receiving visitors today." —Agent Gabe Jones
"We have proved we can punish the guilty. But can we protect the innocent?" —Ayo, leader of the Midnight Angels
Everett learned from his experiences escorting Wakandan royalty. This time he brought a bigger car and an extra pair of pants.
"Redwing and I are here, Cap. And we brought some reinforcements."
Wakanda's dogs of war keep it safe from the shadows.
"Behind me. Now."
"WHAT DO YOU MEAN 'BIG THREE'?!" —Hulk
Never interrupt a villain when they are making a long-winded mistake.
"Do not assume that Wakanda is only the land. Look to the stars and you will find us there." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
And so was born the Fantastic Four! And from that moment on, the world would never again be the same!
"T'Challa may not be of my blood, but he is my son. I will suffer no threats to his kingdom."
"Here we are again, Victor. This is how it always goes." —Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
"Invading Wakanda is the last mistake you will ever make, Doom." —Shuri, the Black Panther
"There are dangers from my past I can still fight. Maybe that's the path to redemption."
"Reed Richards of Earth-616, it is time you reached your full potential."
"Woooof!"
"I couldn't possibly make all of this mischief alone. Oh, hello there, handsome!"
The power of the Hulk and the intelligence of Bruce Banner in one.
"Did you not see the big 'No Soliciting' sign out front?" —Iron Man, Tony Stark
On trial for sparing Galactus, Reed Richards found a cosmic truth and an unexpected ally.
"I have always believed that the essential part of winning is enjoying your opponent's humiliation."
When the screams subsided, only the dry slither of scales and the hiss of cold breath remained.
"Zemo insults me by tasking me with weaklings such as you. Even together, you pose no challenge." —Radioactive Man, Dr. Chen Lu
"You brainless fool! You've set me free!"
"I believe I can shed some light on this situation."
There's always room for a little more firepower.
"I am always here, my son. We all are." —King T'Chaka
"Welcome, T'Challa, to the City of the Dead." —Bast
"Let it end where it began, at Warrior Falls." —T'Challa, the Black Panther
A mantle passed on through sacrifice and love.
After a perilous journey, the Fantastic Four beheld Attilan, the Great Refuge of the Inhumans.
Rivals at the start, and rivals to the end.
"Will you prove worthy of my blessing?"
"That's the thing about the Avengers and their heroics. So easy to predict. So easy to foil!" —Grim Reaper, Eric Williams
"Hello there. Expecting someone else?"
"All the heroes are out there fighting their own battles. Someone has to connect the dots."
"Matchstick, you're on toast. Suzie's got the waffles. Stretch, keep that OJ coming. The kids and I will stand here and look pretty." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
"What if . . . we're not the only versions of us?" —Ms. Fantastic, Lyja Storm (Earth-982)
"To me . . . my Galactus!"
"Reality is what I make of it."
"Monster! You've faced the muscle of Wakanda. Now face its claws."
"Wotta revoltin' development." —The Thing, Ben Grimm
"I want to build a different future than the tomorrow I see on the horizon. What kind of man am I if I don't do everything I can to make that happen?" —Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
"They remain as sharp as they were the day they first cut the air."
After the thirteenth time Reed Richards overloaded the New York City electric grid, he built the Baxter Building its own power supply.
Wakandan defenses are centuries ahead of the rest of the world.
"I'm Reed Richards. The ultimate Reed Richards. The one who's finally going to solve everything." —The Maker
Immensely powerful, the Prowlers may be released only by Wakanda's royal family.
"My name is Rama-Tut, Kang of Kangs. Look upon my works, ye Mighty, and despair!" —Statue inscription
From the great rock that fell from the sky, Bashenga, the first king, forged a blade to protect the land.
"Clothes that won't burn off? Finally!" —Human Torch, Johnny Storm
"When I first came here, I was a little awestruck, thinking of everyone who came before. Now all I feel is pride." —Shuri
Four people emerged from the wreckage more fantastic than when they had begun their flight.
"Too many heroes in New York City? Hey, I'm not complaining. It certainly makes team-ups easier!" —Human Torch, Johnny Storm
"I . . . have . . . awakened! After countless centuries, I live again!" —Fin Fang Foom
Odin's son journeyed to the icy realm of Jotunheim, seeking to test his raging thunder against the Frost Giant horde.
"Avengers Mountain is built inside of a Celestial corpse. Weird? Yes. But we go jogging in the femoral artery, so it has its perks." —She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
The city skyline is full of hope. Even if the worst should befall New York, it has heroes to stand up for it.
"You swabs did all right. But I got my own crew ta get back to. Ship's yers now. Sail 'er well." —Blackbeard the Pirate, Ben Grimm
"Fetch, Jeff! Good boy, Jeff! No, don't bite that man's hand off, Jeff!" —Gwenpool
Wakanda's true nature remained hidden for centuries, disguised from the eyes of outsiders by their own blind assumptions.
Time with family cures many ills.
Deep within Subterranea dwell the fearsome Lava Men, beings made of living magma.
"Did you see that? Did you see that? The Wasp waved at *me*!" —Kamala Khan
"I have witnessed the creation of all life on this world and its inevitable end. There is nothing in between to challenge one such as me." —Kang the Conqueror
"We learn many lessons from nature, my son. See how the panther patiently stalks the herd through the tall grass, waiting for the right moment to strike?" —King T'Chaka, to his young son T'Challa
"Birnin Zana is not a cold and dead city like those of other nations. Our city lives. It *thrives*." —Queen Mother Ramonda
"No longer art thou God of Thunder! Nor shall Mjölnir serve thee now!" —Odin, to Thor
"How did I get here? I'm not rich. Not a mutant. Not a natural. I just try harder."
"A lot of people told me I could never do this work. I've been proving those people wrong my whole life."
For warriors of Asgard, there can be no more welcome sight than the Valkyries entering the fray atop their noble steeds.
"You're going to have to do better than just killing me." —Wonder Man, Simon Williams
"Thank you for visiting the Advanced Idea Mechanics laboratory. You will now be eradicated. Goodbye!"
"I don't think you understand the gravity of the situation. Let me show you!"
"I can't be everywhere at once, but they can." —Iron Man, Tony Stark
"Every detail matters. It's *my* life on the line in this thing."
"I wouldn't want to catch these. They're sharp, you know?"
"My robot army stands guard night and day! For no one knows what is best for you—except your mighty sovereign!" —Doctor Doom
"Let's see if you still believe wrestling is all fake once we're through with you."
"Dormammu—hear me now! Grant me the strength of the Dark Dimension." —The Hood, Parker Robbins
"When I became CEO, Roxxon was stepping up their renewable energy program. I took us in the opposite direction. Weaponry."
"Time for my closing argument!" —She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters
"One giant knuckle sandwich, comin' right up!"
"Consider yourselves served."
"Puny humans! Still you get in my way!? That just makes me mad. And the madder I get . . . the stronger I am!"
"Possibility is limited only by imagination."
"Shove off, Spider-Man! Step aside, Torch! There's a new Super Hero in town! I'm gonna make Dad so proud."
"The thoughts in my head, they go all animal. Eyesight turns blood red until nothing of me is left."
"You mean there was a *whole planet* of Groots out there?" —Rocket Raccoon
"To have such a brother is to be filled with pride!"
"Nobody's catchin' me without a fight!"
The Five Tribes are not without internal strife. But to outside invaders, they show only one face: Wakanda.
"I wish you guys would fire your weapons a little down and to the left. I've got an itch under my ribs like you wouldn't believe!"
"I'm totally awesome!"
"I'm from the Thirtieth Century. They call me Kang . . ."
"I wear this uniform out of respect for Captain America . . . Isaiah Bradley, my grandfather."
"Sorry, Mom! We have insurance, right?"
"Stay down, there's a hundred more where that came from."
No matter where they are or what they're doing, when the signal activates, the Avengers assemble.
"Truly, you are my greatest creation." —Ultron
"You wish to get up, brother? It is very simple! All you have to do is be worthy!" —Thor
"Doom has found diversion in the thrust and parry of our storied struggle. But you have fallen behind, Richards. Now you shall fall asunder!"
"I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."
Throughout the ages Mount Wundagore has yielded wonders, supernatural and scientific, sacred and profane.
A place of perfect calm in a raging world.
"Braddock Manor is fraught with memories, both joyous and heartbreaking." —Captain Britain, Brian Braddock
A strange mountain that rises from the surface of the sea like an unearthly, grotesque face.
As the Quinjet soars overhead, something stirs in the swamp below, roused by the strong wills of the heroes on board.
"I've got to do this Spider-thing no matter what pain or misery awaits me—this is a Spider-Girl World!" —Spider-Girl, Mayday Parker
"I haven't always been the best hero. But I've always been the fastest!" —Blur, Stanley Stewart
"Yes sir, Cap! I won't let you down."
"Don't be jealous if he likes me better, Sam. Redwing is like, my brother now. Sort of."
"Matt! I think I found our exculpatory . . . Matt? Where does he get off to?"
"Those costumed clowns had their chance. Now it's our turn."
"Go out, fight hard, screw up. Save the world a few times . . . Just keep taking the shots, okay?"
"We've been fightin' this or that war our whole lives. And yeah, war is hell, but spend enough time in hell and you can fight like the devil." —Dum Dum Dugan
"Truth without compromise. Thought without error. All things for the betterment of the whole."
In the darkest times, she shines brightest.
"Mar-Vell is part of me now. Like I am of him." —Rick Jones
"Enjoy your stay, Zemo. The quiet should help you ponder the consequences of your actions."
"Tell Fury the intelligence checked out and we're taking out the trash now. This HYDRA cell didn't stand a chance." —Phil Coulson, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.
"When you said 'no man can equal you'? You had to know that was just begging for Jen to hit you." —Spider-Man, Peter Parker
"Hail Wakanda! Hail Damisa-Sarki!"
"It's the first ship back to Skrullos, gentlemen. There will be no invasion today."
"We Utopians don't just dream of a better world, we make the world better."
"Take away your air, and you're nothing but food for the crabs."
"Hardly the jewel of my collection. Yet even the most absurd of specimens has its place." —The Collector
"Our kingdom stretches to every corner of the planet. We are her true rulers." —Princess Fen
"To quote the *real* Thor: 'I say thee nay.'"
"I don't know if I'd call that 'an equal and opposite reaction,' but it sure was fun to watch!" —Invisible Woman, Sue Storm
"It's no Redwing, but it'll do." —Captain America, Sam Wilson
"Move along folks. Move along."
"The Supreme Intelligence guides our empire. It requires a constant infusion of knowledge."
"Everyone knows we Poppupians can turn ourselves into anything, just by thinking of it!"
"You haven't seen *anything* yet!"
"Haha! My thickheaded brother, will you never learn?" —Loki
"What a grim place Asgard would be without me. Absent chaos, there is but tedium."
"We are Kang. We shall conquer."
"I do not need to control reality when I can manipulate your perception of it. You see what I want you to see."
"I believe that if you look hard enough, everything has an answer."
"For the Majestrix! For Chandilar!"
"The currents are treacherous here, and we know them all."
"My quest takes me through strange myriad dimensions. For a lesser being this would be a fatal endeavor, but Thanos endures."
At the Time Variance Authority, Chronomonitors ceaselessly scan existence for temporal misconduct.
"No time like the present. No present like the future."
"This new suit has some interesting possibilities, Mister Stark."
"If I am to be called 'The Vision,' is it not logical for me to look the part? Spectral . . . unearthly . . ."
"A simple plan. If you can fly."
"I guess someone needs a little more negative reinforcement."
"No matter where you flee, I shall find you and destroy you!" —Melter, Bruno Horgan
"Does the spider offer mercy to the fly?"
"I mainly joined up for the benefits . . ."
"I have always been the savior of the human race. I'm simply wearing a more acceptable mask."
"If I already possess so much, what more could I want? Why, the rest of it, of course!"
"My Masters of Evil is a *for-profit* organization, not a vendetta."
"Those who dare stand against Doom do not stand for long!"
"You've got a problem? I'm The Fixer. I fix things. It's what I do."
"This city is wide open, just itching for someone to come along and take it."
He's an ace pilot and fighter jet, all in one.
"You're fired!"
"Radiation is my plaything—but now it will become your doom!"
"Let's see some of that famously radioactive blood, Spider-Man!"
"My armor was created with but one thought in mind . . . to smash Iron Man!"
Once the Hand has its hooks in you, there is no escape. Not even in death.
"Before unleashing my master plan, I will pay back those few animals who dared defy me in the past."
"Something good always comes out of something evil in the long run. It's a messy thing." —The Void
"There will be no justice for Tony Stark. Only vengeance, dispensed with his own tools of destruction."
"Assassinations only happen to important people. It's a compliment!"
"Mayhaps you've fought a Thor, but you've never fought this Thor."
"Spider-Man pulls his punches. I don't."
The Steins lamented their son didn't inherit their genius. Chase was just glad he didn't inherit their evil.
"Paladin always gets his man."
"To look upon me . . . is to see the end of life."
"We're never alone. That's the deal. Forever."
"You're about to learn something about The Human Torch . . . I'm just too hot to handle!"
"I went the day I turned eighteen. I wanted to fly. More than anything in the world." —Colonel Carol Danvers
"I'm not hiding who I am anymore."
"I built the suit with car parts. Finally getting to put my three university degrees to good use."
"Sweet Christmas!"
"Foul villain! Have at thee and feel the might of Mjölnir!"
"I *can too* help! Don't leave me in the Leapfrog!"
"Care for a little race, Tommy?" —Quicksilver, Pietro Maximoff
"We're powered up here, folks. And I added a few toys I think you're really going to like." —Fabian Stankiewicz
"I'm not an Avenger. I'm not Peter. I'm just a kid in a mask doing the best I can. But I'll never give up on anyone that needs me. I'm Miles Morales. And I'm Spider-Man."
"Every strength was a weakness once. Don't you ever forget it."
No matter how many times they are disassembled, teleported, or possessed, their love always brings them back together.
"I made a family, just like everyone else." —Scarlet Witch, Wanda Maximoff
"The wind is unstoppable. Just like me!"
In the Golden Age, he fought alongside the mightiest heroes in the All-Winners Squad. He's slowed down since then but, as is the case with many heroes, retirement didn't quite take.
"I am the old ways from which we came. I am here because the universe demanded it."
"I've got a body that can stop traffic!"
"I talk to the dirt and the dirt talks back. And you listen to Black Tom—the dirt knows everything."
"Lost my limbs in an accident. Roxxon labs put me back together as a snake. Zemo offers me a job . . . I go where I'm wanted."
"Behind me comrades! Use my armored body as a shield!"
"His kind was never known to run from danger." —Moon-Boy
"No door? No problem!"
"Name's Flatman. I'm the deputy leader of the Great Lakes Avengers! And I need answers!"
"I did it, Jan! Hank Pym will be overlooked no more!"
"He's a hitman. Who's a monkey. You don't believe me. Look around you, dude—he's real!" —Deadpool, Wade Wilson
The world seems to stand still, trembling on the brink of infinity, as his ear-splitting scream fills the air!
"Who's a good boy?" —Hawkeye, Clint Barton
